messages:
maya: Heads-up — spotted an inconsistency between the model catalog row for orion-13b-quant and the model card. Catalog lists "embeddings: yes" and max_input_tokens: 8192, but model card docs/ orion-13b.md still say embeddings unsupported and max_input_tokens: 4096. This is causing the examples/embeddings.md SDK snippet to fail CI. Any quick takes?

alex: @maya thanks for flagging. Can you paste the failing CI log and the exact snippet that's breaking? I can start a docs PR once we confirm the source of truth.

maya: Pasting the failing snippet + CI error:
```
# examples/embeddings.md (JS snippet)
const res = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'orion-13b-quant',
  input: ['hello world']
});
// CI error: Model orion-13b-quant does not support embeddings (ApiError: incompatible model)
```
CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs-runs/8823 (failing job)

dev-doc-bot: CI failed for branch update/orion-embeds-docs (#834) — tests: examples/embeddings.md (see details) :warning:

jeremy: Quick context — runtime v0.8.3 added embedding support for the quantized orion variants (KV cache + cast fixes). We updated the runtime team changelog but forgot to propagate that to the docs/catalog. The source of truth is runtime manifest + model onboarding spreadsheet; catalog was updated but model card wasn't.

tess: Also note that we changed the recommended min_runtime_version for orion-13b-quant -> 0.8.3 because of a backend behaviour change when batching embeddings. So the model card should mention the runtime min version under compatibility.

alex: Ok action plan:
1) Update model card docs/orion-13b.md to mark embeddings supported and bump max_input_tokens to 8192. Add a compatibility line: "Requires Redwood runtime >= 0.8.3 for quantized embedding support."
2) Update catalog row (if needed) and add a short migration note in docs/migrations/quant-embedding.md explaining the runtime bump and the reason.
3) Fix the JS + Python snippets in examples/embeddings.md to include a runtime check comment and a link to the migration note.
4) Add a tiny unit test that uses the SDK snippet with model: 'orion-13b-quant' so CI catches regressions.

maya: I'll take 1 + 2 (editing model card and catalog metadata). Leaving a quick note in the model-card PR to include the min_runtime_version field.

jeremy: I'll open a runtime PR that adds a manifest flag for "embeddings_supported: true" for orion-13b-quant, so downstream tooling (catalog updater) can pick it up reliably. Linking once open.

alex: I'll open the docs PR for 3 + 4 today. Drafted branch: docs/update-orion-embeds-195900. Will ping for reviews.

maya: Thanks. One more: we should also add a short benchmark note under the model card — quantized embeddings have ~1.8x slower embedding latency vs full FP on CPU fallback; add the bench numbers so customers know perf tradeoffs. I'll attach the bench CSV.

alex: SG. Add bench lines like: "Embeddings throughput (quantized, single-GPU): 120 req/s (64-token average) — see benchmark table."

dev-doc-bot: Created PR #901 in docs (update-orion-embeds-195900) — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/901 — CI queued.

jeremy: Quick approve once PR lands — will verify runtime manifest PR is merged first. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll mark this as a docs priority patch so we don't ship contradictory info. If anyone sees other model cards with inconsistent max_input_tokens vs catalog, tag me and I'll sweep them. :pray:
